subject: Pre-prefix orphaning on INV-202803 — request for per-request logs & VAT evidence
messages:
From: Anya Patel <billing@fastretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Unexpected invoice line - INV-202803 (orphaned pre-prefix tokens & VAT tagging)

Hi Ben,

We're holding payment on invoice INV-202803 while our tax team completes a review. On line items for 'embed-v2' usage (2028-03-01 to 2028-03-24) we see a large chunk of tokens (3k+ requests) attributed to prefixes that our system doesn't recognize — they all start with "pre_" (example: pre_upload_8345.*). These requests are being billed under our EU entity which is causing reverse-charge VAT confusion.

Specifically we need:
- Per-request evidence (request_id, model, sequence_length, timestamp, route) for the 2028-03-05 -> 2028-03-12 window.
- Mapping of those "pre_" prefixes back to ingestion jobs / API keys so we can reconcile against our internal pipelines.
- Confirmation of whether these requests were classified as "production" or "staging" for billing attribution.
- A VAT-ready statement showing whether Redwood considers these tokens chargeable under our EU entity or if they should be reverse-charged.

We attached the invoice stub INV-202803.pdf and highlighted the disputed line. Our tax team needs the evidence to either release payment or approve a provisional credit. Can you triage and tell me the expected timeline?

Thanks,
Anya Patel
Head of Billing, FastRetail
Anya.Patel@fastretail.com

Attachment: INV-202803.pdf (invoice stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Anya Patel <billing@fastretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 09:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected invoice line - INV-202803 (orphaned pre-prefix tokens & VAT tagging)

Hi Anya — thanks for the clear note and the invoice. Sorry for the disruption; we'll prioritize this.

Quick plan of action:
1) Marcus: can you run a per-request export for 2028-03-05..2028-03-12 filtered on prefixes starting with "pre_" and the model "embed-v2"? We need request_id, api_key/tenant_tag, route, sequence_length, and the raw timestamp.
2) Kimberly: could you confirm how Redwood labels these prefixes for VAT classification (which entity is billed when tenant_tag is missing)?
3) I'll propose a provisional credit if we confirm orphaning caused misattribution and keep FastRetail's payment on hold until we deliver the evidence.

Anya — can you confirm the preferred format (CSV vs JSON) for the per-request evidence and whether a signed credit note is acceptable for your finance team as interim proof?

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Internal ticket: RB-4281

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Anya Patel <billing@fastretail.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 02:17:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected invoice line - INV-202803 (orphaned pre-prefix tokens & VAT tagging)

Ben / Anya — initial findings below. I pulled a targeted export against the ingestion ledger and the request router for the window 2028-03-05 00:00 -> 2028-03-12 23:59 UTC.

Summary:
- Total token count attributed to "pre_" prefixes: 3,421 token-requests (not tokens; request-level entries), majority model=embed-v2.
- 2,980 of those map to a background replay job labeled "batch-preprocess-03" (job id: bp03-77), which was running from 2028-03-05T03:14 -> 2028-03-05T05:55 UTC. That job used a staging API key that did not have an explicit tenant_tag set; the runtime fallback labeled those requests with the global EU tenant for billing.
- Remaining ~441 requests are scattered across two ephemeral keys tied to an internal transform process (pre_ingest-##) that also defaulted to the EU billing entity.

Sample lines (redacted):
> 2028-03-05T03:19:42Z request_id=rq_8a3c pre_prefix=pre_upload_8345 model=embed-v2 seq_len=64 api_key=stg-xxxxx route=/v1/embeddings
> 2028-03-05T03:20:01Z request_id=rq_8a7f pre_prefix=pre_upload_8346 model=embed-v2 seq_len=128 api_key=stg-xxxxx route=/v1/embeddings

Root cause (prelim): background replay + staging keys without tenant tags were billed to the EU entity by our routing fallback. That's why FastRetail's EU tax team sees unexpected charged activity.

Proposed next steps:
- We can generate a per-request CSV with the fields you requested (request_id, timestamp, route, seq_len, api_key, billing_entity). I can attach a 500-row sample immediately (see attached sample-preprefix-logs.txt).
- We're prepared to issue a provisional credit of $2,400 while engineering patches the fallback tagging and we complete a full audit.
- Engineering will add a hard fail / notification for any staging key invoking production routes without tenant_tag to prevent recurrence.

I'll produce the full export by EOD UTC and the formal provisional credit note for your accounting.

Marcus Lin
Manager, Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachment: sample-preprefix-logs.txt (partial export, 500 rows sample)

From: Anya Patel <billing@fastretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:47:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected invoice line - INV-202803 (orphaned pre-prefix tokens & VAT tagging)

Thanks Marcus — that aligns with what our platform team suspected.

FastRetail accepts the provisional credit of $2,400 while you provide the full export. For our tax/audit team to clear the invoice we need:
- Full per-request CSV for the 2028-03-05 -> 2028-03-12 window with the fields: request_id, timestamp (ISO8601), model, seq_len, route, api_key (redacted to prefix), billing_entity, and any associated job_id.
- A one-page statement confirming Redwood's position on VAT (i.e., whether those requests should be reverse-charged under FastRetail EU or billed to Redwood EU entity) so our tax lead can close the loop.
- The provisional credit note as a PDF that our AP team can attach to the payment.

If you can get the CSV and PDF credit note into the shared Drive folder (link above) by EOD Friday 2028-03-30 UTC we will release the remaining balance and mark INV-202803 as paid that day. A DocuSign is not required if the credit note is signed and on Redwood letterhead.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Anya Patel
Head of Billing, FastRetail
